Lux

Mid Pure meme

Lich Bane one-shot Lux

How to play this build

In lane, poke with E (Lucent Singularity) and punish with Q if you land the root. Your one-shot sequence: Q to root, weave a Lich Bane auto, E, DFG and ult (Final Spark). With Rabadon + Void, a squishy won't survive. Zhonya saves you if dove. Huge range but no escape: position well.

Skill order

Max priority:

E Singularidad Lúcida → Q Atadura de Luz → W Singularidad Prismática

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
E (Lucent Singularity) for poke and damage; Q second for the root. W (shield) at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Lich Bane AP, mana and move speed; attack after a spell deals huge magic damage scaling with AP. Key for AP auto builds.
  2. Deathfire Grasp The classic burst item: AP + active that deals % target-health damage and amplifies your next hit. One-shots.
  3. Rabadon's Deathcap The biggest AP item in the game: multiplies your total AP.
  4. Void Staff AP and % magic penetration; a must vs. enemies stacking MR.
  5. Sorcerer's Shoes Boots with magic penetration.
  6. Zhonya's Hourglass AP and armor; stasis active makes you invulnerable and untargetable for a couple seconds.

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/0/9 — Offense
Why this page
21/0/9 full AP so the Lich Bane combo one-shots.
